card.name: Emberfield

program.notes: Warm communal barn and feast hall in the caldera
Cosy homes with gardens, lit by lava glow

story.text: the friendly residents settled the volcano

card.interpretation: A warm, welcoming farm town that lives inside a volcano: fields on terraces lit by lava glow, red and black materials softened with warm wood and lanterns.

contradictions.issue: a cozy farm town in a hellish setting
contradictions.resolution: keep the hellish setting for the walls and sky; make the buildings and farms warm and welcoming

assumptions: farming works under lava glow with artificial light
